description: This file contains a constant-time, bitsliced implementation of AES encryption and decryption, including key schedule setup, block processing, and various transformations optimized for different hardware capabilities (SSE2, 64-bit, 32-bit). It supports multiple AES key sizes and batch processing of multiple blocks, with functions for ECB, CBC, and CTR modes.

methods.name: aes_nohw_set_encrypt_key
methods.description: Initializes AES_KEY with the provided key and key size (128, 192, 256 bits).

methods.name: aes_nohw_set_decrypt_key
methods.description: Sets up the decryption key schedule (currently identical to encryption setup).

methods.name: aes_nohw_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a single 16-byte block using the prepared key.

methods.name: aes_nohw_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a single 16-byte block using the prepared key.

methods.name: aes_nohw_ctr32_encrypt_blocks
methods.description: Performs CTR mode encryption on multiple blocks with a given IV.

methods.name: aes_nohw_cbc_encrypt
methods.description: Performs CBC mode encryption or decryption on data blocks.
